course.title: Quantitative Reasoning & Statistics
course.credential_boundary: 3 internal Khaemenes learning units; not institutional college credits.

modules.title: Numbers, Ratios & Rates
modules.essential: How quantitative claims depend on units, scales, ratios and rates.

lessons.title: Units, Magnitude and Estimation
lessons.focus: Use units, orders of magnitude and estimation to test numerical plausibility.

lessons.title: Ratios, Rates and Proportions
lessons.focus: Interpret part-to-part, part-to-whole and per-unit relationships.

lessons.title: Percent Change and Percentage Points
lessons.focus: Distinguish percent change from absolute and percentage-point change.

modules.title: Tables, Graphs & Visual Evidence
modules.essential: How visual displays can clarify or distort quantitative relationships.

lessons.title: Reading Tables and Structured Data
lessons.focus: Extract comparisons, totals, rates and missing context from tables.

lessons.title: Axes, Scales and Graph Integrity
lessons.focus: Detect truncated axes, uneven scales and visual exaggeration.

lessons.title: Choosing Effective Displays
lessons.focus: Match bar charts, line charts, histograms and scatterplots to the question.

modules.title: Describing Distributions
modules.essential: How center, spread and shape summarize one-variable data.

lessons.title: Mean, Median and Mode
lessons.focus: Choose and interpret measures of center.

lessons.title: Range, IQR and Standard Deviation
lessons.focus: Compare measures of variability and sensitivity to outliers.

lessons.title: Shape, Outliers and Distribution Stories
lessons.focus: Describe skew, clusters, gaps and unusual observations.

modules.title: Sampling & Measurement
modules.essential: How data quality depends on who or what is measured and how.

lessons.title: Population, Sample and Sampling Frame
lessons.focus: Distinguish target populations from observed samples.

lessons.title: Bias, Nonresponse and Convenience Samples
lessons.focus: Identify common pathways from sampling design to misleading conclusions.

lessons.title: Measurement, Variables and Operational Definitions
lessons.focus: Define variables so that measurements match the intended concept.

modules.title: Probability & Uncertainty
modules.essential: How probability represents uncertainty and supports rational expectations.

lessons.title: Events, Complements and Simple Probability
lessons.focus: Model basic chance events and complements.

lessons.title: Conditional Probability and Independence
lessons.focus: Interpret probabilities that change with new information.

lessons.title: Expected Value and Long-Run Reasoning
lessons.focus: Use weighted outcomes to compare uncertain choices.

modules.title: Relationships Between Variables
modules.essential: How association differs from causation and how variables move together.

lessons.title: Scatterplots and Association
lessons.focus: Describe direction, form and strength in paired quantitative data.

lessons.title: Correlation and Its Limits
lessons.focus: Interpret correlation without treating it as causation or complete description.

lessons.title: Confounding and Alternative Explanations
lessons.focus: Identify variables that may create or distort observed associations.

modules.title: Risk, Rates & Public Claims
modules.essential: How to interpret medical, civic, financial and media statistics responsibly.

lessons.title: Absolute Risk and Relative Risk
lessons.focus: Translate relative claims into underlying frequencies.

lessons.title: Base Rates and Denominators
lessons.focus: Ask what population and denominator a rate actually describes.

lessons.title: Per-Capita and Standardized Comparisons
lessons.focus: Compare groups fairly when size or composition differs.

modules.title: Inference & Margin of Error
modules.essential: How samples support cautious conclusions about larger populations.

lessons.title: Sampling Variability
lessons.focus: Understand why different samples produce different estimates.

lessons.title: Confidence Intervals in Plain Language
lessons.focus: Interpret intervals as uncertainty around an estimate without common misconceptions.

lessons.title: Margin of Error and Sample Size
lessons.focus: Explain how precision changes with sample size and variability.

modules.title: Hypothesis Tests & Practical Significance
modules.essential: How statistical evidence differs from real-world importance.

lessons.title: Null Models and P-Values
lessons.focus: Interpret p-values as compatibility with a null model, not proof of a claim.

lessons.title: Statistical Versus Practical Significance
lessons.focus: Distinguish detectable effects from meaningful effects.

lessons.title: Multiple Testing and Selective Reporting
lessons.focus: Recognize how repeated testing can manufacture apparently surprising results.

modules.title: Data Ethics & Reproducibility
modules.essential: How responsible quantitative work preserves context, privacy and auditability.

lessons.title: Data Provenance and Documentation
lessons.focus: Record where data came from and how they were transformed.

lessons.title: Privacy, Consent and Harm
lessons.focus: Consider ethical limits on collecting and sharing data.

lessons.title: Reproducible Analysis and Transparent Methods
lessons.focus: Make calculations and decisions inspectable by another person.

modules.title: Quantitative Decision-Making
modules.essential: How numerical evidence supports comparison without replacing judgment.

lessons.title: Cost, Benefit and Tradeoff Tables
lessons.focus: Organize competing quantitative and qualitative criteria.

lessons.title: Forecasts, Scenarios and Sensitivity
lessons.focus: Test how conclusions change when assumptions change.

lessons.title: Communicating Uncertainty to Non-Specialists
lessons.focus: Explain numbers, risk and limits without false precision.

modules.title: Integrated Data Inquiry
modules.essential: How to complete a small quantitative investigation from question to evidence-based communication.

lessons.title: Question, Data and Analysis Plan
lessons.focus: Frame a quantitative question and identify the data needed.

lessons.title: Analysis Brief and Visual Evidence
lessons.focus: Produce a concise analysis with appropriate summaries and graphics.

lessons.title: Capstone Quantitative Defense
lessons.focus: Defend conclusions, limitations and what additional data would change them.

assessment.capstone: small quantitative investigation + visual evidence + analysis brief + defense
